title: UzEngine Skeleton
description: UzEngine skeleton file (.uzskeleton) — bone hierarchy definition with bind pose transforms. Referenced by skinned meshes (.uzmesh) and animation sequences (.uzanimsequence). Bones are stored in a flat array where parent indices form the tree.

name.description: Skeleton display name (typically matches the character/rig name).

bones.description: Flat array of bones ordered by index. Bone 0 is always the root. Parent indices must reference earlier bones (DAG constraint).

name.description: Bone name matching the DCC tool naming (e.g., 'Hips', 'Spine', 'LeftArm'). Used for animation retargeting.

parent.description: Parent bone index. -1 for root bones. Must be < this bone's index (forward reference not allowed).

bind_position.description: Local bind pose position relative to parent [x, y, z].

bind_rotation.description: Local bind pose rotation as quaternion [x, y, z, w].

bind_scale.description: Local bind pose scale [x, y, z].

retarget_chains.description: Named bone chains for animation retargeting between different skeletons (e.g., 'spine', 'left_arm', 'right_leg').

bones.description: Ordered list of bone indices forming this chain (root to tip).
